Implemented the full project in `/workspace`, with the core library in [pyquery/pyquery.py](/workspace/pyquery/pyquery.py), the unified API export in [pyquery/__init__.py](/workspace/pyquery/__init__.py), HTTP loading in [pyquery/openers.py](/workspace/pyquery/openers.py), packaging in [setup.py](/workspace/setup.py), upstream-style docs/tests, and runnable examples in [examples/basic_usage.py](/workspace/examples/basic_usage.py) and [examples/form_serialization.py](/workspace/examples/form_serialization.py). I also added `.gitignore` and `.hgignore`.

The implementation includes the jQuery-like traversal/manipulation API, pseudo-selectors, form serialization, multi-source loaders, URL fetching, camelCase aliases, and current-environment compatibility fixes for `lxml` 6 / Python 3.13, including textarea value handling, modern HTML entity parsing, and HTTP opener behavior.
